title: Shroud of Turin dating tested later repair cloth

tellings.quote: there were several repair jobs that were done to it. And so you have se several pieces of cloth that were much younger than the original piece of cloth.

plain: The Shroud of Turin, a linen cloth kept in Italy that many believe wrapped the body of Jesus, is said to have been dated using pieces of later repair cloth, which were "much younger than the original." The researcher Randall Carlson tells this without naming a source, saying the cloth had several repair jobs over the centuries. If true, it would mean the test that made the shroud look young was measuring the patches, not the original.
